name: Xu xoa
summary: Xu xoa is the cool seaweed sweet. Vietnam Airlines uses sea grapes from around Lý Sơn, palm sugar, ginger, and coconut milk. ZaloPay describes a pale-brown jelly with reduced syrup and coconut milk, and does not name palm sugar or ginger.
taste: Vietnam Airlines calls it cool, mildly sea-scented, and gently sweet. ZaloPay calls it soft and chewy, pale brown, with a light sea smell.
howToEat: Vietnam Airlines: rau câu chân vịt from around Lý Sơn, cooked, set, and cut, then dressed with palm sugar cooked with ginger and coconut milk. Sold in a plastic box or a vacuum pack.
ZaloPay: a natural seaweed jelly, eaten with reduced sugar syrup and a little coconut milk, sometimes with ice.
The culture office names xu xoa at the Don An Phú festival and does not describe it.
No hour was printed. The hour is Check on arrival.
where: Vietnam Airlines places the seaweed around Lý Sơn and does not name a shop in the city. ZaloPay names no street.
priceBand: Vietnam Airlines prints 30,000 VND for a 500 g box. ZaloPay printed no price.
seoTitle: Xu xoa — seaweed jelly in Quang Ngai
seoDescription: Xu xoa, the seaweed sweet. Vietnam Airlines prints 30,000 VND for 500 g and uses palm sugar and ginger. ZaloPay describes a syrup and coconut milk. The hour is Check on arrival.
